info.name: Get a client's most recent risk tolerance report

params.name: clientId
params.description: Unique identifier of a client

params.name: rtqType
params.description:
Questionnaire type identifier.
- `FM10S30` - 10 questions
- `FM25V30`- 25 questions

params.name: disclosureType
params.description:
Indicates if disclosure is needed.
- `1` - Include disclosure.
- `2` - Do not include disclosure.

params.name: ignoreSections
params.description:
Determines the sections NOT to include in the report.If not specified, all the sections will be included. Multiple valuses must be comma-separated. Accepted values are:

  * `RISK_TOLERANCE`
  * `USING_YOUR_PROFILE`
  * `RISK_TOLERANCE_SCORE`
  * `RISK_GROUP`
  * `YOUR_DIFFERENCES`
  * `FOOTNOTES`

items.docs:
Get a client’s risk tolerance report based on the most recently submitted responses to the risk tolerance questionnaire. The report includes sections on:


  * Risk tolerance score
  * Risk group
  * Differences
  * How to use the report
  * Footnotes

In the `ignoreSections` parameter, specify any sections you do not want returned in the response.

Report types include: </br></br> - X-Ray</br>- Snapshot </br> - Hypothetical Growth </br>- Investment Details </br> - Stock Intersection </br>- Disclosure </br></br>To override the default value in the Accept-Language HTTP header, use the `langcult` parameter.

params.name: period
params.description:
Time period for reports in quarters:
0 = Current quarter
1 = Previous quarter
n = nth quarter from the current quarter
-1 = Current and previous quarter

params.name: name
params.description: Name search string

params.description: Unique identifier of a bucket. Default is root bucket.

params.description: Unique identifier of a client

params.name: published
params.description: When set to `published` returns published reports only

items.docs: Get reports metadata including `reportId`. </br></br>You must enter a time period for the request to query in the `period` parameter. Time period is measured in quarters:</br> - `0` = Current quarter. For example, if today is 2021-07-31, returns reports for 2021-07-01 to 2021-09-30.</br> - `1` = Previous quarter. For example, if today is 2021-07-31, returns reports for 2021-04-01 to 2021-06-30.</br> - `n` = nth quarter from the current quarter. For example, `4` returns reports of the 4th quarter
